git-hero.title: Git Hero
git-hero.description: Fast and visual TUI for managing Git, written in Rust with Ratatui. A modern alternative to lazygit and gitui with interactive dashboard, 10 themes, i18n support, and CLI mode.
git-hero.longDescription: Git Hero is a high-performance Terminal User Interface (TUI) for managing Git repositories. It offers a visual dashboard with branch, remote, ahead/behind, file panel with change indicators, side-by-side diff, expandable commit history, and support for mouse and vim-like shortcuts. Includes 10 customizable themes, i18n (EN/ES), non-interactive CLI mode, and debug mode, all distributed via cargo, Homebrew, AUR, and snap.
git-hero.feature1: Visual dashboard with branch, remote, ahead/behind
git-hero.feature2: File panel with change indicators and side-by-side diff
git-hero.feature4: 10 customizable themes (Tokyo Night, Gruvbox Dark, Dracula, Nord...)
git-hero.feature5: Stage/unstage, commits, push/pull/fetch, stash, and branch management
git-hero.feature6: i18n support (English/Spanish), mouse, and vim-like shortcuts
git-hero.feature7: TUI interactive, non-interactive CLI, and debug modes

vitrina.title: Vitrina
vitrina.description: Full-stack e-commerce demo with catalog, filters and cart built on Next.js 16 and the Shopify Storefront API, ready to switch to a real store.
vitrina.longDescription: Vitrina is a portfolio demo store that replicates the complete e-commerce experience: product catalog with search and filters, detail page, shopping cart and embedded checkout, powered by the Shopify Storefront API through Hydrogen React. Built with Next.js 16 App Router, Tailwind CSS v4 and next-intl for ES/EN internationalization, with a sober editorial design (burgundy + ivory). No real payments: swapping in a store's credentials takes the project to production without rewriting code.
vitrina.feature1: Catalog with search, filters and sorting
vitrina.feature5: Editorial design with burgundy and ivory palette
vitrina.feature6: Ready to switch to a real store with credentials
